{{Quote|My name is Kenna and I'm a collector. I gather and catalog examples of the many living species of the galaxy.|Kenna to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="TC" />}}
'''Kenna''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Collector/Legends|collector]], active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He collected species from across the galaxy in an underground [[Carbonite/Legends|Carbonite Freezing]] collection. He froze many [[Separatist Droid Army|separatist]] leaders in the substance and attempted to freeze [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in it. However, Mace defeated Kenna and frozen him in the material for transport while he was tried for his crimes.
